title: Adaptive episodic eval sentinel for staged traffic and automated rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
Build a lightweight "sentinel" service that continuously evaluates model responses against rotating episodic eval prompt sets (small, high-signal golden slices) during canary, A/B, and shadow traffic. The sentinel should compute multi-dimensional scorecards, produce a composite confidence-aware regression signal, and integrate with the rollout conductor to trigger automated quarantine/rollback when risk thresholds are exceeded.

Goals:
- Detect subtle quality regressions across customer-relevant prompt slices within minutes of traffic hitting a canary or shadow population.
- Avoid false-positive rollbacks by using ensemble signals: per-prompt scoring, cohort weighting, and bootstrap confidence intervals.
- Support dynamic episodic sets: rotate small golden samples weekly and allow per-customer augmentations.
- Expose observability in Console with per-model/per-canary dashboards and alerting hooks.

Scope & non-goals:
In scope: sentinel scoring pipeline, integration with rollout conductor (canary/rollback API), dashboard surfaces, canary test harness, test-suite for synthetic regressions.
Out of scope for this ticket: UI for user-editable episodic sets (follow-up PM/UX).

Design decisions and trade-offs considered:
- Small episodic sets (50-200 prompts) vs large scorecard: smaller sets give fast signal but higher variance; we use stratified sampling + temporal rotation to reduce variance while keeping detection fast.
- Composite signal: we combine metric deltas (BLEU-like/embedding-similarity/semantic-fallback rates) with behavioral checks (token truncation, hallucination heuristics). A weighted sum with confidence intervals avoids single-metric flips causing rollbacks.
- Auto-rollback policy is conservative: requires composite delta beyond hysteresis band plus 95% bootstrap CI and at least 2 independent cohorts affected (global + region or customer cohort) before triggering automatic reversion.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Eval sampler: component that maintains episodic sets per model and per customer segment; supports rotation TTL and sampling biases to keep coverage.
2) Scoring engine: executes the canonical prompts on the candidate and baseline models, computes per-prompt metrics and aggregate scorecards; supports pluggable metrics.
3) Sentinel aggregator: computes weighted composite, performs bootstrap CI, and evaluates gating rules.
4) Integration: wire sentinel outputs to rollout conductor (canary API) and to alerting/console dashboards.
5) Test harness and simulation: replay historical canary traffic and inject synthetic degradations to validate false-positive/negative rates.

Acceptance criteria:
- Sentinel evaluates a 100-prompt episodic set for a canary within 8 minutes of traffic start at targeted canary scale (1% traffic).
- Composite signal false-positive rate < 0.5% on historical baseline replays; true-positive detection of injected regression magnitude >= 5% within 30 minutes in 95% of simulations.
- Console shows per-prompt breakdown and composite score; alerts fire to the SRE/Oncall channel when gating rules are violated.

Artifacts & links:
- Design doc (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/EPIC-3422/episodic-eval-sentinel
- Simulation harness repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-sim
- Runtime PR (scoring engine prototype): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1284
- Console dashboard draft: /console/dashboards/eval-sentinel

Open questions and risks:
- How to version episodic sets and keep auditability for regulatory customers? (Need small index and immutable snapshots stored in S3 + manifest.)
- Cost: running canonical prompts against baseline for every canary increases token cost; mitigation: adaptive sampling where stable prompts are less frequently re-run and new prompts get heavier weight.
- Multi-tenant privacy: some customers require private golden sets; sentinel should support private mounting or per-customer sentinel instances in Private deployments (follow-up engineering story).

Next steps / current work:
- Completed prototype of scoring metrics and bootstrap CI (runtime PR linked above).
- Integration spike with rollout conductor started; initial contract agreed with rollout team (see convo in the PR).
- Simulation underway with 18 months of historical canary traffic; preliminary results show detection of large regressions but miss small style regressions — tuning in progress.

Estimated effort: 8 points.

QA & rollout plan:
- Stage 1: run sentinel in shadow for internal models for 2 weeks; observe false positives and tune weights.
- Stage 2: enable sentinel for low-risk customer canaries with email-only alerts.
- Stage 3: enable automatic quarantine/rollback for internal and selected customers with human-in-loop confirmation for first 2 weeks.
